# van: a mesh for the world to draw in 3D. The nose looks along -x, the sliding door and the blanket are on the -y side.
# van.mesh: magic CBMESH1, uint32 vertices, uint32 indices; per vertex 40 B: float32 pos xyz (m, z up,
#   the footprint's centre on the ground at 0), float32 normal xyz, float32 uv, uint8 rgb (display sRGB),
#   uint8 kind (0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp), uint8 texture (0 none, else a row below), 3 pad;
#   then uint32 indices, 3 per triangle. A textured face: colour and alpha from the texture, cut under 0.5.
front -x
vertices 7601
triangles 8172
bytes 402120
texture 1 van_tex1.png 1024 1024
texture 2 van_tex2.png 512 512
texture 3 van_tex3.png 1024 768
